decisions.reason: The beige color selected for the cursive K on green buttons does not change the DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity.
The source selects the color of a button marking and does not change the machine name, placard wording, placement, or sides.
The button marking color is aesthetic and does not change press-to-dispense interaction or any dispensing behavior.
The button marking color has no effect on bowl capacity, size, depth, or form.
The source concerns the color of the cursive K on the buttons and does not alter spout geometry, construction, or orientation.
The localized button marking color choice does not change the system-layout or CAD deliverable state.
The button marking color does not affect matcha texture, foam consistency, or mixing behavior.
The aesthetic color choice does not modify the electrical wiring-plan deliverable.
The button marking color has no effect on splash targets or high-speed splash mitigation.
The source specifies a visual marking color but does not necessarily change component selection, ordering status, or the BOM.
The button marking color does not change bowl removal, swapping, clearance, or cleaning access.
The aesthetic button marking decision does not alter plumbing seals or liquid-containment requirements.
